definitions.gloss: transfer of the capital; moving the capital to a new location
definitions.explanation: The act of relocating the national capital from one city to another. A key concept in Japanese history, where the capital was moved multiple times.

examples.japanese: 794⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{遷都|せんと}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The capital was moved to Kyoto in 794.

examples.japanese: {遷都|せんと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧さまざまな⟦{説|せつ}→説：00360_setsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are various theories about the reasons for moving the capital.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明治|めいじ}→明治：19860_meiji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{初|はじ}め→初め：02931_hajime⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{天皇|てんのう}→天皇：04546_tennou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{移|うつ}った→移る：01232_utsuru⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{事実上|じじつじょう}→事実上：11419_jijitsujou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遷都|せんと}だった。
examples.english: The Emperor's move from Kyoto to Tokyo in the early Meiji era was a transfer of the capital in all but name.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- A⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{遷都|せんと}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to move the capital to A
- A⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧B⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遷都|せんと}: the transfer of the capital from A to B

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遷都|せんと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to carry out a transfer of the capital
- {遷都|せんと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧: a plan to move the capital

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan's best-known moves are to Nara (710) and to Kyoto (794, as {平安京|へいあんきょう}). The move to Tokyo in 1868–69 was never formally proclaimed, so historians often call it ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧{奠都|てんと} rather than {遷都|せんと}. Modern proposals to move government functions out of Tokyo are discussed as ⟦{首都|しゅと}→首都：03224_shuto⟧⟦{移転|いてん}→移転：04000_iten⟧.
